title: Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machines: Interpretable Quantum Machine Learning with Commuting Projector Clauses
abstract: arXiv:2608.18659v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tsetlin Machines (TMs) learn interpretable Boolean clauses using finite-state automata. We introduce the Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machine (QL-TM), which replaces Boolean literals with quantum propositions represented by projectors while retaining classical include/exclude automata. Clauses are restricted to commuting measurement contexts and activate through the Born probability of their joint projector. We prove an exact reduction to ordinary Boolean TM clauses in diagonal computational-basis contexts and connect Pauli-projector clauses to stabilizer and syndrome semantics. Controlled experiments on Bell states, phase-flip syndromes, randomized 16-class stabilizer tasks, mixed literal pools, context-budget ablations, and finite-shot noise show that correct non-diagonal contexts recover physically meaningful clauses, while diagonal or wrong contexts lose the relevant phase/syndrome information. translated_title: 量子逻辑Tsetlin机器：基于交换投影子句的可解释量子机器学习
translated_abstract: Tsetlin机器（TMs）利用有限状态自动机学习可解释的布尔子句。我们引入了量子逻辑Tsetlin机器（QL-TM），它将布尔文字替换为由投影子表示的量子命题，同时保留经典的包含/排除自动机。子句被限制在交换测量上下文中，并通过其联合投影子的Born概率激活。我们证明了在对角计算基上下文中，QL-TM能精确简化为普通布尔TM子句，并将Pauli投影子子句与稳定子及综合征语义联系起来。在Bell态、相位翻转综合征、随机16类稳定子任务、混合文字池、上下文预算消融和有限噪声实验上的控制实验表明，正确的非对角上下文能恢复物理上有意义的子句，而对角或错误上下文则丢失相关的相位/综合征信息。上下文预算结果紧密遵循理论预期。
tldr: 本文提出量子逻辑Tsetlin机器（QL-TM），通过将布尔子句替换为交换投影子量子命题，实现了可解释的量子机器学习，并证明其在非对角上下文中能有效捕获量子相位和综合征信息。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machines (QL-TM), which replace Boolean clauses with commuting projector-based quantum propositions, enabling interpretable quantum machine learning and demonstrating effective capture of quantum phase and syndrome information in non-diagonal contexts.
